episodeTitle.en: Al Engineering 101 with Chip Huyen (Nvidia, Stanford, Netflix)
episodeTitle.zh: Al工程入门：与奇普·许（Chip Huyen，Nvidia、斯坦福大学、Netflix）对话

guestBioOfficial.en: Chip Huyen is a core developer on Nvidia’s Nemo platform, a former AI researcher at Netflix, and taught machine learning at Stanford. She’s a two-time founder and the author of two widely read books on AI, including AI Engineering, which has been the most-read book on the O’Reilly platform since its launch. Unlike many AI commentators, Chip has built multiple successful AI products and platforms and works directly with enterprises on their AI strategies, giving her unique visibility into what’s actually happening inside companies building AI products. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh:
奇普·许恩（Chip Huyen）是英伟达Nemo平台的核心开发者、曾任网飞（Netflix）人工智能研究员，并在斯坦福大学教授机器学习。她曾两次创业，并著有两本广受欢迎的人工智能书籍，包括《AI工程》（AI Engineering），该书自上线以来便成为O'Reilly平台上阅读量最高的书籍。与许多人工智能评论员不同，奇普亲手打造了多个成功的人工智能产品和平台，并直接与企业合作制定人工智能战略，这让她对构建人工智能产品的企业内部运作有着独特的洞察力。  
*我们讨论：*

title.en: Al Engineering 101 with Chip Huyen (Nvidia, Stanford, Netflix)
title.zh: Al工程入门：与奇普·许（Chip Huyen，Nvidia、斯坦福大学、Netflix）对话

summary.en: Chip explains ML basics accessibly—pretraining, post-training, RAG, reinforcement learning, RLHF—and then gets into what it actually takes to build great AI products versus what people assume. She argues most companies stall not for lack of tools but because they don't understand their users' real needs and can't measure productivity gains. The conversation is a clear, practical guide to avoiding the “AI hype gap” and shipping products that work.
summary.zh: Chip 以易懂的方式讲解机器学习基础——预训练、后训练、RAG、强化学习、RLHF——并深入探讨打造优秀 AI 产品真正需要什么，而非人们想当然的。她认为多数公司停滞不是因为缺工具，而是不理解用户真实需求、无法衡量生产力提升。对话是避开“AI 炒作鸿沟”、交付真正可用产品的清晰实用指南。
